THE OWNER-ACCEPTED STANDING RED HAS CLEARED — WoWMeta re-ran upstream. Both JSON API files fetched with plain curl, no headers, no proxy, no auth, and the web page deliberately not touched (it is a stale S3 prerender). manifest.json returned completedAt 2026-09-08T14:03:05Z and snapshotDate 2026-09-08; the rankings file rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json returned 162,405 bytes with Last-Modified Tue, 08 Sep 2026 09:11:42 GMT, so the two agree and this is not the 08-04 pinned-manifest shape. Selected the 3 blocks whose categoryType is in {dps, hps, tank} AND sortField === lowerBound AND keyRange is absent, whitelisting those three types rather than blacklisting "dungeon" — melee and ranged are subsets of dps and would silently double-count 27 specs. 27 + 7 + 6 = 40 rows, className/spec byte-identical to the roster, 0 unmatched. Merged lowerBound as "M+ lower-bound 95% CI rating (Blizzard API, population-wide)" rounded to ONE decimal to match the stored series precision (a precision mismatch reports a whole series as moved), n = numberOfCharacters, asOf = the source's own snapshotDate. All 40 values moved, max 6.94% (Frost Mage 296.9 -> 317.5) — a week of real population drift, comfortably inside maxValueMovePct 0.6 and maxFamilyMedianMovePct 0.35. The raid endpoint was not touched: its lowerBound is DPS throughput on a different scale and must never merge under the M+ rating name.
